name: RISE Robotics
description: RISE Robotics is a pioneer in high-performance linear actuation, developing the RISE Cylinder to replace inefficient hydraulic systems in heavy machinery. By enabling full electrification of industrial vehicles, their technology significantly reduces energy consumption and carbon emissions for the multi-billion dollar construction and material handling industries. The company is currently scaling production with major OEM partners to modernize global heavy-duty fleets.

founders.name: Hiten Sonpal
founders.bio: Robotics exec with experience at iRobot and Electric Sheep; generated over $2B in revenue.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Ranked #1 Reg CF Campaign in 2025 by Kingscrowd with over $5.7M committed from 2,500+ investors.

highlights: Replacing hydraulic systems in heavy machinery

name: Aerial Resupply Coffee
tagline: Caffeine & support for a new generation of veterans
description: Aerial Resupply Coffee is a veteran-owned and operated specialty coffee brand focusing on high-quality roasts and community support for the military and first responder sectors. Since its founding, the brand has grown a loyal following of over 20,000 customers through a robust D2C model and expanding retail presence. The company emphasizes authenticity and mission-driven growth within the competitive consumer goods landscape.

founders.name: Michael Klemmer
founders.bio: 20-Year U.S. Army Veteran and Bronze Star Recipient.

updates.title: Customer Milestone
updates.body: Reached over 20,000 customers across D2C and retail channels.

highlights: Expanding into retail and B2B channels

name: Biostate AI
description: Biostate AI is building a general-purpose artificial intelligence platform designed to revolutionize drug discovery and personalized healthcare. By leveraging massive biological datasets and advanced machine learning, the company aims to extend human lifespan and improve health outcomes for 90% of the population. Led by a team of award-winning bioengineers, the company has secured significant backing from premier venture capital firms.

founders.name: Dave Zhang
founders.bio: Bioengineering professor with 60+ publications; previously co-founded a diagnostics company with $20M+ revenue.

updates.title: VC Backing Secured
updates.body: Successfully raised $20M from VCs including Accel and Matter Venture Partners.

highlights: $20M raised from leading VCs like Accel

name: Koios Medical, Inc.
tagline: AI-powered ultrasound software for cancer detection
description: Koios Medical develops FDA-cleared and CE-marked AI software that assists physicians in detecting cancer earlier and more accurately through ultrasound imaging. Their technology reduces unnecessary biopsies while improving the detection rate of malignant tumors in breast and thyroid examinations. The company is experiencing rapid global adoption and is integrated into major medical imaging systems.

founders.name: Chad McClennan
founders.bio: Healthcare visionary who co-founded a medical software company acquired by Stryker.

updates.title: Revenue Growth
updates.body: Reporting 200%+ growth and on path to breakeven in 2026.

highlights: Newsweek's 'World's Best Digital Health Company' award

name: Groma Real Estate Trust
tagline: AI-powered real estate built for steady returns
description: Groma is a technology-enabled real estate investment trust that utilizes proprietary AI to acquire and manage multi-family residential properties. By automating property management and acquisition workflows, Groma offers investors a streamlined way to access institutional-grade real estate returns with monthly liquidity options. The company focuses on urban residential assets with a high degree of operational efficiency.

founders.name: Seth Priebatsch
founders.bio: Serial founder who built and sold LevelUp to Grubhub for approximately $400M.

updates.title: Portfolio Milestone
updates.body: Reached $100M+ portfolio value with 9 consecutive quarters of distributions.
